mapper.sql: r.id as registrationId, r.member_id as memberId, r.parent_order_no as parentOrderNo, r.owner_type as ownerType, r.owner_id as ownerId, r.order_num as orderNum, r.payable_amount as payableAmount, r.total_amount as totalAmount, r.payment_type as paymentType, r.payment_status as paymentStatus, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.payment_time as paymentTime, r.create_time as createTime, coalesce((select sum(f.refund_amount) from refund_application f where f.source_type = 'registration' and f.source_id = r.id and f.del_flag = 0 and f.status = 1 and f.payout_status in (1, 4)), 0) as settledRefundAmount, (select count(1) from refund_application f where f.source_type = 'registration' and f.source_id = r.id and f.del_flag = 0 and (f.status = 0 or (f.status = 1 and f.payout_status in (0, 2, 3, 5, 6)))) as pendingRefundCount, (select count(1) from refund_application f where f.source_type = 'registration' and f.source_id = r.id and f.del_flag = 0 and f.status = 1 and f.payout_status in (1, 4)) > 0 as hasSettledRefund
mapper.select: select distinct r.member_id from cms_registration r where r.member_id is not null and r.payment_time is not null and r.payment_time >= #{from} and r.payment_time < #{toExclusive} order by r.member_id asc

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select b.member_id as member_id, date(b.obtain_time) as stat_date, b.obtain_time as occurred_at, 'PLAYER_BADGE_TOPIC_FINISH' as source_kind, concat('badge:', b.id) as fact_key from player_badge b where b.del_flag = 0 and b.source_type = 2 and left(b.badge_code, 13) = 'TOPIC_FINISH_' and b.member_id is not null and b.obtain_time >= #{from} and b.obtain_time < #{toExclusive} union all select s.member_id as member_id, date(s.finished_at) as stat_date, s.finished_at as occurred_at, 'ROAM_SESSION_FINISHED' as source_kind, concat('roam:', s.id) as fact_key from roam_session s where s.status = 1 and s.member_id is not null and s.finished_at >= #{from} and s.finished_at < #{toExclusive} union all select t.member_id as member_id, date(t.completed_at) as stat_date, t.completed_at as occurred_at, 'TOPIC_ROUTE_SESSION_COMPLETED' as source_kind, concat('route:', t.id) as fact_key from topic_route_session t where t.status = 1 and t.completed_at is not null and t.member_id is not null and t.completed_at >= #{from} and t.completed_at < #{toExclusive} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select c.member_id as member_id, date(c.created_at) as stat_date, c.created_at as occurred_at, 'TOPIC_COMPLETION_COUPON' as source_kind, concat('coupon-log:', c.id) as fact_key from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log c where c.created_at >= #{from} and c.created_at < #{toExclusive} union all select x.member_id, date(x.granted_at), x.granted_at, 'TOPIC_COMPLETION_XP', concat('xp-award:', x.id) from topic_completion_xp_award x where x.granted_at >= #{from} and x.granted_at < #{toExclusive} union all select p.member_id, date(p.create_time), p.create_time, 'ROAM_POI_REWARD', concat('poi-reward:', p.id) from roam_poi_reward_log p where p.coupon_history_id is not null and p.create_time >= #{from} and p.create_time < #{toExclusive} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select m.owner_member_id as member_id, date(m.create_time) as stat_date, m.create_time as occurred_at, 'COMMUNITY_PRIVATE_PHOTO' as source_kind, concat('media:', m.id) as fact_key from community_post_media m join community_post p on p.id = m.post_id where p.audience = 'PRIVATE' and m.retention_state = 'ACTIVE' and m.upload_state = 'ATTACHED' and m.create_time >= #{from} and m.create_time < #{toExclusive} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select p.author_id as member_id, date(p.published_at) as stat_date, p.published_at as occurred_at, 'COMMUNITY_PUBLIC_POST' as source_kind, concat('post:', p.id) as fact_key from community_post p where p.lifecycle = 'PUBLISHED' and p.audience = 'PUBLIC' and p.published_at is not null and p.published_at >= #{from} and p.published_at < #{toExclusive} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select e.member_id as member_id, date(e.occurred_at) as stat_date, e.occurred_at as occurred_at, concat('reco-click:', e.event_name) as source_kind, coalesce(e.idempotency_key, concat('event-row:', e.id)) as fact_key from biz_event_log e where e.member_id is not null and e.event_name in ('finish_route_recommendation_click', 'roam_exploreday_reco_click') and e.occurred_at >= #{from} and e.occurred_at < #{toExclusive} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select e.member_id as member_id, date(e.occurred_at) as stat_date, e.occurred_at as occurred_at, concat('client-reported:', e.event_name) as source_kind, coalesce(e.idempotency_key, concat('event-row:', e.id)) as fact_key from biz_event_log e where e.member_id is not null and e.event_name in ('mission_complete', 'play_arrive_success', 'play_arrive_fallback', 'roam_finish', 'finish_route_recommendation_shown') and e.occurred_at >= #{from} and e.occurred_at < #{toExclusive} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind
mapper.sql: coalesce(case when r.owner_type = 1 then r.owner_id end, a.topic_id, r.topic_id)
mapper.select: select r.id as registrationId, as topicId from cms_registration r left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and a.id = r.owner_id where r.id in #{registrationId}

select raw.member_id as memberId, raw.stat_date as statDate, raw.source_kind as sourceKind, min(raw.occurred_at) as firstOccurredAt, max(raw.occurred_at) as lastOccurredAt, count(distinct raw.fact_key) as factCount from ( select t.member_id as member_id, date(t.completed_at) as stat_date, t.completed_at as occurred_at, 'TOPIC_ROUTE_SESSION_COMPLETED' as source_kind, concat('route:', t.id) as fact_key from topic_route_session t where t.status = 1 and t.completed_at is not null and t.member_id is not null and t.completed_at >= #{from} and t.completed_at < #{toExclusive} and t.topic_id in #{topicId} ) raw group by raw.member_id, raw.stat_date, raw.source_kind

select 'cms_registration.payment_time' as sourceName, max(payment_time) as watermarkAt from cms_registration union all select 'cms_registration.create_time', max(create_time) from cms_registration union all select 'refund_application.registration.update_time', (select max(f.update_time) from refund_application f where f.source_type = 'registration' and f.del_flag = 0) union all select 'player_badge.obtain_time', max(obtain_time) from player_badge union all select 'roam_session.finished_at', max(finished_at) from roam_session union all select 'topic_route_session.completed_at', max(completed_at) from topic_route_session union all select 'topic_route_session.update_time', max(update_time) from topic_route_session union all select 'topic_completion_xp_award.granted_at', max(granted_at) from topic_completion_xp_award union all select 'cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log.created_at', max(created_at) from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log union all select 'roam_poi_reward_log.create_time', max(create_time) from roam_poi_reward_log union all select 'community_post.published_at', max(published_at) from community_post union all select 'community_post_media.create_time', max(create_time) from community_post_media union all select 'biz_event_log.occurred_at', max(occurred_at) from biz_event_log
